meta.name: understand-figma
meta.description: Analyze a Figma file via the Figma REST API and generate an interactive design knowledge graph (pages, screens, components, component sets, instances, design tokens) with a kind:"design" dashboard.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析 Figma 文件并生成交互式设计知识图谱
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要从 Figma 设计稿中提取结构化信息
copy.tagline_en: Analyze Figma files and generate an interactive design knowledge graph
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to extract structured information from Figma designs

howto.what: Claude 会读取你给的 Figma 文件链接或 key,通过 Figma REST API 抓取页面、屏幕、组件、组件集、实例与设计令牌,生成可交互的设计知识图谱,并在现有仪表盘里展示。
howto.when: 当你提供 Figma 文件链接或 key 并要求分析时触发;需要 FIGMA_TOKEN 环境变量、Node ≥ 22 等前提。

say.note: 扫描该文件并生成设计图谱

say.note: 强制重建,忽略已是最新的提示

howto.what_en: Claude reads a Figma file URL or key, pulls pages, screens, components, component sets, instances and design tokens through the Figma REST API, and builds an interactive design knowledge graph shown in the existing dashboard.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you give a Figma file URL or key and ask for analysis; it needs a FIGMA_TOKEN environment variable and Node ≥ 22.

Runs the analysis in the given language
